title: Shoplifting
grade_or_penalty: Graded by value: 2nd degree $75,000+; 3rd degree $500 to under $75,000; 4th degree $200 to $500; disorderly persons under $200. Shopping cart removal is a separate lesser offense
key_points: Taking or concealing merchandise, altering price tags, or transferring merchandise between containers with purpose to deprive the merchant.
Merchants and officers may detain a suspect in a reasonable manner for a reasonable time with probable cause.
Mandatory community service for shoplifting convictions.
elements: The suspect took possession of, carried away, concealed, altered or transferred merchandise (or under-rang it as a cashier, or removed a shopping cart)
The merchandise was offered for sale by a store or retail establishment
With purpose to deprive the merchant of it without paying the full retail value
Determine the full retail value (sets the grade)

subsections.label: b(1)
subsections.text: Takes possession of, carries away, transfers or causes to be carried away merchandise with purpose to deprive the merchant

subsections.label: b(2)
subsections.text: Conceals merchandise on his person or otherwise with purpose to deprive

subsections.label: b(3)
subsections.text: Alters, transfers or removes a price tag or label with purpose to pay less

subsections.label: b(4)
subsections.text: Transfers merchandise from one container to another with purpose to deprive

subsections.label: b(5)
subsections.text: Under-rings: a cashier rings up a lesser price with purpose to deprive

subsections.label: b(6)
subsections.text: Removes a shopping cart from the premises without consent with purpose to deprive

subsections.label: c
subsections.text: Grading: $75,000+ = 2nd; $500 to under $75,000 = 3rd; $200 to $500 = 4th; under $200 = DP. Mandatory community service on conviction

subsections.label: e
subsections.text: Merchants and officers may detain a suspect in a reasonable manner for a reasonable time with probable cause, with immunity from civil liability
